background.text: That makes all of this easier when you have a boss and a family that embraces your own family. Yeah, for sure. Tim Murtaugh, I was reading, he talked about in the campaign how you would hold or at least try to hold Bible studies there at the campaign, at least however it was, virtually or maybe in person. Tell me about that. That's neat, these Bible studies that you were trying to keep going.

ground_truth: Yeah, we started that every Friday. It was a few weeks before, or probably two months before I left the campaign to come here. My sister, Ryan McEnany, works on the campaign. My assistant, Lindy Rose, who's now with me here in the White House, worked at the campaign as well. And another woman named Sunny Joy Nelson and the three of us came together and we said, you know, we represent so many Christians across this country. When I was at the campaign, obviously, it's very evident the evangelical community has supported this president. And so is the Catholic community and the faith community at large. And so we said, you know, to do that justice, we need to have prayer in this building and we need to have Bible study and time in the word. And so before work, we would all gather for about 45 minutes and we do what we started to call popcorn prayer, where we would just pray out loud. And one of my good friends, you know, Abigail Robertson taught me this concept with the Bible study that she does. And it was just organic and spontaneous. And we would pray and read the word. And it just gave a little pep in ourselves. And it was a little bit of a first step because these days are demanding, they're challenging, they're long in politics. Whether you're a Democrat or Republican, that's the nature of the job. And that just I think it was a little rod of lightning of just energy and joy in our day. And it definitely transferred throughout the week. And so that Bible study still continues. I'm now at the White House. I'm not part of the campaign anymore, but it continues. And it's a very proud, I guess, if you call it.
